description: Price index of sea and coastal freight transport services (CPA 50.20) sold to French businesses, purchaser's price for contract escalation (INSEE services sell price index BtoB, prix de marche); container-cycle dominated
source: INSEE (Banque de donnees macro-economiques), Indices de prix de production et de vente des services (IPPS base 2021)
notes: Released ~57-59 days after quarter end (Informations Rapides IPSE: Q1-2025 on 2025-05-28, Q2 on 2025-08-28, Q3 on 2025-11-27, Q4 on 2026-02-26); 60 used. Latest vintage. Not a spot index: a realised (contract+spot) price of sea freight bought by French businesses; reflects container lines' Asia-Europe pricing with a short lag.

description: Trailing 4-quarter mean of INSEE sea-freight price index (CPA 50.20, BtoB purchaser price); contract-renewal proxy (annual/two-year contracts reprice toward the past year's market level)
notes: Same release timing as the underlying index (all four quarters are published by the time the latest one is).

description: Europris inbound-freight contract regime: sign of y/y change in contracted freight cost in effect in the quarter (+1 higher, -1 lower, 0 no announced change), coded only from Europris announcements made before the forecast origin
source: Europris ASA stock-exchange releases (Oslo Bors NewsWeb)
notes: Constructed so the value for quarter q uses only announcements dated on/before q end + 45 days (the project's forecast origin); lag 0 so the harness uses the origin quarter's value. +1 2022Q1-Q4 (NW 552536, 2022-02-03), -1 2023Q2-Q4 (NW 577619, 2022-12-08), +1 2024Q1-Q4 (NW 609575, 2024-02-01); 0 otherwise incl. 2023Q1 (y/y ~-1%) and 2025-26 (no direction announced). Zeros before 2021 are an assumption (no contract change announced).
